title: Remittance of Withheld Amounts to Payee Agencies (Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders)
content:
Amounts deducted from benefit payments under Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders are held by the Department as amounts withheld pending remittance until they are remitted to the payee agency or refunded to the claimant. Their remittance is governed as follows.

## Standing rule

(a) Amounts withheld are remitted to the kind's payee agency on the kind's remittance schedule, no later than the kind's remittance business days after the end of each remittance period, with the kind's remittance report.

(b) A remittance period is remitted once per order. A deduction belongs to the remittance period in which the date of the payment it was taken from falls.

(c) The remitted amount is the deductions taken in the period less any refunded before remittance, so that the amount withheld pending remittance for the period returns to zero; a payment listed with a skipped deduction is reported where the kind requires it.

(d) Federal withholding is deposited through EFTPS and reported on Form 945, so a claimant asking about a federal deposit is told it is reported on Form 1099-G rather than on a W-2.

## The remitted amount, restated

| Element | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Deductions taken from payments dated in the period, under the order | Included |
| Of those, deductions refunded to the claimant before remittance | Excluded |
| Remittance for the same order and period already made | No second remittance |
| Amount withheld pending remittance for the period, after remittance | Zero |

## Worked period (hypothetical figures)

Under one order, three deductions are taken from payments dated within one remittance period: $30.00, $30.00 and $25.00, a total of $85.00 withheld pending remittance. Before the period is remitted, one $30.00 deduction is refunded to the claimant as taken in error, leaving $55.00 pending. The period is remitted once, for $55.00, after which the amount withheld pending remittance for that period is zero.

## Points of judgement

- *A second remittance for a period already remitted under the same order.* Not made: each period is remitted once per order.
- *A claimant asks why federal withholding does not appear on a W-2.* Federal withholding from benefits is deposited through EFTPS and reported on Form 945; for the claimant it is reported on Form 1099-G, not on a W-2.
- *A payment from which a deduction was skipped.* It is reported to the payee agency with the remittance where the kind requires it.
